name: codealong
description: Auto-pause and resume coding tutorials in Chrome based on your activity in VS Code.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode --noEmit && tsc -p packages/chrome --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config e2e/vitest.config.ts
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build && cd packages/vscode && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o ../../dist/codealong-vscode.vsix
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
